snippet.title: Zeroth - Official Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
We're Contrary Games and we're hard at work on our debut title, Zeroth. 

Zeroth is a run-based action platformer with mechanical depth and interplay inspired by traditional Roguelikes like Nethack. Learn the rules of the world through hilarious deaths so that you can guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

We look forward to sharing more as the project develops!
